title: RoboRecast: Intent-Preserving Demonstration Augmentation via Diagnosis-Driven Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.32622v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Collecting diverse real-world manipulation demonstrations is costly, motivating the use of simulation to augment existing demonstrations for robot policy learning. When objects, layouts, or robots change, transferring motions from a source demonstration can produce behavior that is semantically implausible or physically infeasible in the new setting. We introduce RoboRecast, an agentic optimization framework that preserves the interactions required by the source task while jointly optimizing the simulated scene and robot motion to make those interactions executable in the target setting. When an interaction fails, the agent uses simulation feedback to diagnose the cause, revise the relevant scene or motion parameters, and test whether the revision resolves the failure. This flexibility allows RoboRecast to generate synthetic data from both human and robot demonstrations and to adapt them to new layouts, objects, and robot embodiments.

translated_title: RoboRecast：基于诊断驱动优化的意图保持演示增强
translated_abstract: 收集多样化的真实世界操作演示成本高昂，这促使研究者利用仿真来增强现有演示以用于机器人策略学习。然而，当物体、布局或机器人发生变化时，从源演示迁移动作可能产生在新环境中语义上不合理或物理上不可行的行为。我们提出了RoboRecast，这是一个智能体优化框架，它在保持源任务所需交互的同时，联合优化仿真场景和机器人运动，使这些交互在目标环境中可执行。当某次交互失败时，智能体利用仿真反馈来诊断原因，修改相关的场景或运动参数，并测试该修改是否能解决失败。这种灵活性使RoboRecast能够从人类和机器人演示中生合成数据，并将其适配到新的布局、物体和机器人形态。
tldr: RoboRecast是一个诊断驱动的智能体优化框架，通过联合优化仿真场景与机器人运动来保持源任务交互意图，可从人类和机器人演示生成适配新布局、新物体和新机器人形态的合成训练数据。
en_tdlr: RoboRecast is a diagnosis-driven agentic optimization framework that jointly optimizes simulated scenes and robot motions to preserve source task intent, enabling synthetic data generation from human and robot demonstrations adapted to new layouts, objects, and robot embodiments.
